subjectLabel: 同人版远野志贵 / 七夜志贵 origin split

signals.summary: Original-version Tohno Shiki is the Tsukihime protagonist who gained Mystic Eyes of Death Perception after a previous event and wears Mystic Eye Killer glasses to reduce brain burden.
His true identity is a descendant and sole survivor of the Nanaya demon-hunter family; his original name is Nanaya Shiki.
After the Nanaya family is destroyed by the Tohno family, Tohno Makihisa finds Shiki, adopts him because his name sounds like the Tohno eldest son's name Shiki, and alters his memory with hypnosis.
The source describes Shiki as sturdy, with unruly black hair, rectangular glasses, a dark-blue gakuran, and the ancestral short knife Nanaya.

Before Tsukihime, the Nanaya family accepts Makihisa's invitation to attack the Saiki family; Makihisa then feels threatened by Kiri's inhuman battle ability and destroys the Nanaya family with branch-family help.

Eight years before the story, SHIKI goes mad under the Tohno bloodline's inversion impulse and attacks Akiha; Shiki protects Akiha at the cost of his life, receives a large chest scar, nearly dies, then awakens the Mystic Eyes after waking and forgetting the truth of the inversion impulse.

At early Tsukihime, Shiki leaves school early due to anemia, meets a blond woman in white, loses control after his demon-hunter blood awakens, follows her to an apartment, and cuts her into seventeen pieces with Mystic Eyes and the short knife.
